jobs.description: Join Apple’s Generative AI team in Zurich as a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in foundation model post-training! Our team advances reinforcement learning (RL) for agentic tool use, planning and reasoning to enhance Apple’s foundation models. Our work directly shapes Apple Intelligence features such as Siri—impacting billions of users—while contributing to state-of-the-art research. You’ll collaborate with a dedicated group of researchers in Zurich and work closely with Apple’s core Foundation Model teams in Cupertino and NY.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al team AI Generativo di Apple a Zurigo come Machine Learning Engineer specializzato nel modello di fondazione post-formazione! Il nostro team avanza l'apprendimento di rinforzo (RL) per l'uso degli strumenti agentici, la pianificazione e il ragionamento per migliorare i modelli di base di Apple. Il nostro lavoro forma direttamente le caratteristiche di Apple Intelligence come Siri, che comporta miliardi di utenti, mentre contribuisce alla ricerca all'avanguardia. Collaborerai con un gruppo dedicato di ricercatori a Zurigo e lavorerai a stretto contatto con le principali squadre di Apple Foundation Model di Cupertino e NY.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Apple’s Generative AI team in Zurich as a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in foundation model post-training! Our team advances reinforcement learning (RL) for agentic tool use, planning and reasoning to enhance Apple’s foundation models. Our work directly shapes Apple Intelligence features such as Siri—impacting billions of users—while contributing to state-of-the-art research. You’ll collaborate with a dedicated group of researchers in Zurich and work closely with Apple’s core Foundation Model teams in Cupertino and NY.
descriptionByLocale.de: Schließen Sie sich dem Generative AI-Team von Apple in Zürich als Machine Learning Engineer an, der sich auf das Post-Training von Grundlagenmodellen spezialisiert hat! Unser Team erweitert das Reinforcement Learning (RL) für die agentische Werkzeugnutzung, Planung und Argumentation, um Apples Grundlagenmodelle zu verbessern. Unsere Arbeit prägt Apple Intelligence-Funktionen wie Siri, die Milliarden von Benutzern betreffen, und trägt gleichzeitig zu modernster Forschung bei. Sie arbeiten mit einer engagierten Forschergruppe in Zürich zusammen und arbeiten eng mit Apples Kernteams von Foundation Model in Cupertino und NY zusammen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez l'équipe de l'IA à Zurich en tant qu'ingénieur d'apprentissage automatique spécialisé dans les modèles post-formation ! Notre équipe avance l'apprentissage du renforcement (RL) pour l'utilisation d'outils d'agents, la planification et le raisonnement pour améliorer les modèles de fondation d'Apple. Notre travail façonne directement les fonctionnalités d'Apple Intelligence telles que Siri, qui affecte des milliards d'utilisateurs, tout en contribuant à la recherche de pointe. Vous collaborerez avec un groupe de chercheurs dévoués à Zurich et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de la Fondation modèle Apple à Cupertino et NY.

jobs.description: Ready to transform how billions of people interact with technology? Apple’s Core Foundation Models team is driving the intelligence that powers experiences across billions of devices worldwide—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to join us! Our Europe-based applied ML team is seeking an experienced ML research scientist to spearhead groundbreaking developments in AI! Collaborate with some of the brightest minds across Apple’s centers in New York, Seattle, and Cupertino as we push beyond conventional limits and redefine the possibilities of artificial intelligence globally. Join us on an inspiring journey where your expertise will be instrumental in shaping the next phase of digital interaction—an extraordinary opportunity awaits.

jobs.title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer - Security
jobs.description:
Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture organization is responsible for the security of all Apple products. Passionate about safeguarding users, we believe that the best defense requires a great offense. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most sophisticated operating systems, that means finding vulnerabilities first.

Our mission is to discover, understand, and exploit vulnerabilities across all layers of Apple’s platforms, and we believe that ML techniques significantly enhance our ability to do so. We are seeking an Applied Machine Learning Engineer who will help us invent and deliver these new methods and techniques.

This position provides rare exposure to a full‑stack view of security along with direct access to expert knowledge, unique datasets, and cross‑domain experience. Your contributions will materially raise the security of products used by billions and strengthen Apple’s ability to defend against adversaries.

Can you make a difference on this scale? Join our extraordinary group of security researchers, tool developers, and machine learning experts, and help protect all Apple users.

La nostra missione è scoprire, capire e sfruttare le vulnerabilità di tutti gli strati delle piattaforme di Apple, e crediamo che le tecniche ML migliorano significativamente la nostra capacità di farlo.
• Stiamo cercando un Ingegnere di Apprendimento della Macchina Applicata che ci aiuterà a inventare e fornire questi nuovi metodi e tecniche. Questa posizione fornisce una rara esposizione a una visione completa della sicurezza insieme all'accesso diretto alle conoscenze di esperti, ai dataset unici e all'esperienza cross-domain. I vostri contributi aumenteranno materialmente la sicurezza dei prodotti utilizzati da miliardi e rafforzeranno la capacità di Apple di difendersi dagli avversari. Puoi fare la differenza su questa scala? Unisciti al nostro straordinario gruppo di ricercatori di sicurezza, sviluppatori di strumenti e esperti di machine learning e aiuta a proteggere tutti gli utenti Apple.

jobs.description: Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. We are a group of engineers and researchers building multimodal foundation models at Apple, with a particular focus on image understanding and generation. We build infrastructure, datasets, and models with fundamental general capabilities and work with a cross-functional partners to apply these models to ship features to millions of users. We are looking for researchers who are passionate about developing algorithms, techniques, and systems that push the frontier of deep learning and delight millions of users with Apple products powered by foundation models.

Siamo un gruppo di ingegneri e ricercatori che costruiscono modelli di fondazione multimodale a Apple, con una particolare attenzione alla comprensione e alla generazione dell'immagine. Costruiamo infrastrutture, dataset e modelli con capacità generali fondamentali e lavoriamo con un partner interfunzionale per applicare questi modelli per spedire funzionalità a milioni di utenti. Siamo alla ricerca di ricercatori che sono appassionati di sviluppo di algoritmi, tecniche e sistemi che spingono la frontiera di deep learning e deliziano milioni di utenti con prodotti Apple alimentati da modelli di fondazione.

Nous sommes un groupe d'ingénieurs et de chercheurs qui construisent des modèles de fondations multimodales chez Apple, avec un accent particulier sur la compréhension et la génération d'images. Nous construisons des infrastructures, des ensembles de données et des modèles avec des capacités générales fondamentales et travaillons avec des partenaires interfonctionnels pour appliquer ces modèles à des millions d'utilisateurs. Nous recherchons des chercheurs passionnés par le développement d'algorithmes, de techniques et de systèmes qui repoussent la frontière de l'apprentissage profond et ravissent des millions d'utilisateurs avec des produits Apple alimentés par des modèles de fondation.

jobs.title: AI Research Scientist - Multimodal Intelligence
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Multifaceted, amazing people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us in this truly exciting era of Artificial Intelligence to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple products & experiences! We are continuously advancing the state of the art in Computer Vision and Machine Learning, touching all aspects of language and multimodal foundation models, from data collection, data curation to modeling, evaluation and deployment.

As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming research directions in the field of multimodal foundation models that will inspire future Apple products. You will be working alongside highly accomplished and deeply technical scientists and engineers to develop pioneering solutions for challenging problems. This is a unique opportunity to be part of what forms the future of Apple products that will touch the lives of many people. We (Multimodal Intelligence Team) are looking for an AI Research Scientist to work on the field of Generative AI and multimodal foundation models.

Our team has an established track record of shipping features that leverage multiple sensors, such as FaceID, RoomPlan and hand tracking in VisionPro, as well as a strong research presence in the multimodal AI community. Our publications span multimodal pre-training, vision-language models, video-language models, and multimodal alignment. We are focused on building experiences that demonstrate the power of our sensing hardware as well as large foundation models.

descriptionByLocale.it: Immagina cosa potresti fare qui. A Apple, le nuove idee hanno un modo di diventare prodotti straordinari, servizi e esperienze dei clienti molto rapidamente. Porta la passione e la dedizione al tuo lavoro e non c'e' niente da dire a cosa potresti realizzare. Persone sfaccettate e sorprendenti e tecnologie innovative sono la norma qui. Le persone che lavorano qui hanno reinventato interi settori con tutti i prodotti Apple Hardware. La stessa passione per l'innovazione che va nei nostri prodotti si applica anche alle nostre pratiche, rafforzando il nostro impegno a lasciare il mondo meglio di quanto lo abbiamo trovato. Unisciti a noi in questa emozionante era dell'Intelligenza Artificiale per aiutare a fornire i prossimi prodotti e le esperienze di Apple innovative! Promuoviamo continuamente lo stato dell'arte in Computer Vision e Machine Learning, toccando tutti gli aspetti dei modelli di base linguistica e multimodale, dalla raccolta dei dati, dalla cura dei dati alla modellazione, alla valutazione e all'implementazione. Come membro del nostro gruppo dinamico, avrete l'opportunità unica e gratificante di creare le prossime direzioni di ricerca nel campo dei modelli di fondazione multimodali che ispireranno i futuri prodotti Apple. Si lavorerà a fianco di scienziati e ingegneri altamente qualificati e profondamente tecnici per sviluppare soluzioni pionieristiche per problemi impegnativi. Questa è un'opportunità unica per essere parte di ciò che forma il futuro dei prodotti Apple che toccherà la vita di molte persone. Noi (Multimodal Intelligence Team) stiamo cercando uno scienziato di ricerca AI per lavorare sul campo dell'intelligenza genetica e modelli di fondazione multimodale. Il nostro team ha un consolidato track record di funzionalità di spedizione che sfruttano più sensori, come FaceID, RoomPlan e hand tracking in VisionPro, così come una forte presenza di ricerca nella comunità AI multimodale. Le nostre pubblicazioni abbracciano modelli multimodali pre-training, vision-language, modelli in lingua video e allineamento multimodale. Siamo concentrati su esperienze di costruzione che dimostrano la potenza del nostro hardware di rilevamento e grandi modelli di fondazione.

Als Mitglied unserer dynamischen Gruppe haben Sie die einzigartige und lohnende Gelegenheit, zukünftige Forschungsrichtungen im Bereich multimodaler Stiftungsmodelle zu entwickeln, die zukünftige Apple-Produkte inspirieren werden. Sie werden mit hochqualifizierten und zutiefst technischen Wissenschaftlern und Ingenieuren zusammenarbeiten, um zukunftsweisende Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Probleme zu entwickeln. Wir konzentrieren uns auf den Aufbau von Erfahrungen, die die Leistungsfähigkeit unserer Sensor-Hardware sowie großer Fundamentmodelle demonstrieren.

Nous progressons sans cesse dans l'état de l'art de la vision informatique et de l'apprentissage automatique, touchant tous les aspects des modèles de bases linguistiques et multimodales, de la collecte de données, de la curation des données à la modélisation, l'évaluation et le déploiement. En tant que membre de notre groupe dynamique, vous aurez l'occasion unique et enrichissante d'élaborer des orientations de recherche à venir dans le domaine des modèles de fondations multimodales qui inspireront les futurs produits Apple. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de scientifiques et d'ingénieurs hautement accomplis et hautement techniques pour développer des solutions pionnières pour résoudre des problèmes difficiles. C'est une occasion unique de faire partie de ce qui forme l'avenir des produits Apple qui touchera la vie de nombreuses personnes. Nous (Multimodal Intelligence Team) sommes à la recherche d'un chercheur sur l'IA pour travailler sur le domaine des modèles génériques d'IA et de fondation multimodale. Notre équipe dispose d'un dossier établi de caractéristiques d'expédition qui utilisent plusieurs capteurs, tels que FaceID, RoomPlan et le suivi manuel dans VisionPro, ainsi qu'une forte présence de recherche dans la communauté multimodale de l'IA. Nos publications couvrent la préformation multimodale, les modèles de langage de vision, les modèles de langage vidéo et l'alignement multimodal. Nous nous concentrons sur la construction d'expériences qui démontrent la puissance de notre matériel de détection ainsi que de grands modèles de fondation.

jobs.description:
Ready to transform how billions of people interact with technology? Apple’s Core Foundation Models team is driving the intelligence that powers experiences across billions of devices worldwide—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to join us! Join our Europe-based applied ML team building the next generation of large-scale ML and RL training infrastructure for Apple’s foundation models. We develop high-performance, distributed systems that power cutting-edge foundation model research on a massive scale. The success we are striving for is the result of very skilled people working in an environment that cultivates creativity, partnership, and solving old problems in new ways. Protecting over a billion endpoints. Operationalizing security research and threat intelligence into security engineering decisions affecting every layer of the stack. Touching the lives of everyone who interacts with our products. Working for a company whose commitment to user privacy is at the heart of everything it does. Being surrounded by the most creative, passionate, hardworking engineers in the industry. Constantly being challenged to go beyond the norm to find new, innovative ways of solving problems and to make software safer, easier, and more fun to use. You can find all of this in one opportunity, and only at Apple.

jobs.title: AIML - Research Scientist, Health
jobs.description: The Personalized AI for Science (PAIS) team is at the forefront of machine learning and health science at Apple. We are a close-knit team of deeply technical AI/ML research scientists who incubate ambitious research ideas and develop new statistical/ML methodologies, ultimately in service of new Apple health and wellbeing applications. We are seeking a research scientist who combines deep learning (and/or signal processing) experience with a rigorous foundation in statistics. The ideal candidate is passionate about model robustness and scientific rigor, ensuring that the models we deploy meet the high evidentiary standards required of health applications.
